trustLine: 19 Years of Experience in Computer Education and IT Services
founderDescription:
With over 19+ years of extensive experience in Information Technology, Mr. Sampat Sahebrao Bankar is a seasoned technical professional and educator in computer hardware and computer education.

He has built a strong reputation through his practical expertise in computer, laptop, and printer repair, CCTV installation and maintenance, networking solutions, and IT hardware support. Over the years, he has successfully handled technical and hardware operations for 50+ companies, delivering dependable solutions and long-term customer relationships.

In addition to technical services, Mr. Bankar is deeply committed to computer education. With 19+ years of teaching experience, he has trained hundreds of students in courses such as MSCIT, Tally Prime, English-Marathi-Hindi typing, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, and personality development programs. His practical teaching approach focuses on real-world skills, empowering students to become digitally confident and job-ready.
